contentText: In the southwestern French town of Fleurance , the parents of 11-year-old Lyhanna joined thousands of people on June 7 for a silent march in her memory. There is growing outrage at systemic failures in the judicial system blamed for the girl's suspected murder. Her body was found last week after she went missing on May 29 near Fleurance. The main suspect had previously been accused of sexually abusing children.
